shared_or_similar_visual_information: A curved overlap region formed by intersecting circular outlines. On the left, use the tan lens containing 2, 13 and 19. On the right, use one of the gray curved components between the white central overlap and a pair of outer arcs.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The lens lists the elements that belong to both A and B. Right image: The gray components consist of locations inside exactly two of the three circles. The center common to all three is unshaded.
Rationales: The left lens encodes joint membership in two named sets. The right gray region selects pieces of a geometric area by circle coverage.
